hero: Autologic Industries is an IATF 16949 certified manufacturer in Delhi and an auto parts supplier for Kenya. We export motorcycle and three-wheeler clutch systems, brake shoes, engine parts and aluminium castings.

Boda bodas carry passengers and goods across Nairobi, Mombasa and rural counties, and tuk-tuks are common in many towns. Long working days on dusty and uneven roads wear clutches and brakes quickly. Browse our range below. Every component is tested in our plant before it is packed for export to Mombasa.

network.title: Why Kenyan Buyers Work With Us
paras: We have produced drivetrain parts for more than 25 years and test every component before dispatch.
One manufacturer for clutch, brake and casting parts keeps ordering simple and quality consistent.
Our team can suggest a starter range covering the most common boda boda and tuk-tuk repairs, based on your model list.

network.title: Shipping Parts to Kenya
paras: Orders travel by sea in palletised export packing to Mombasa, with complete documents for your clearing agent.
Motorcycle, tuk-tuk and casting items can share a container, and repeat shipments can be scheduled.
Dust-protected packing helps parts reach upcountry warehouses in good condition.

cta.title: Sourcing parts for the Kenyan market?
cta.text: Share your part list, models or drawings with quantities. Our export team will confirm fitment and send a quotation for delivery to Kenya. Samples can be arranged before your first volume order.

faq_intro: Quick answers for importers, traders and assemblers in Kenya. Our export team replies to enquiries with fitment notes and clear commercial terms.
faqs: Do you supply boda boda and tuk-tuk parts to Kenya?
Yes. Our range covers motorcycle and three-wheeler clutch parts, brake shoes, engine components and aluminium castings.
Can I order a mixed container?
Yes. Different product lines can be combined in one shipment and labelled by model.
Can you make parts to our drawings?
Yes. Our die casting and CNC lines produce components from drawings or samples after a feasibility review.
Can I test samples before a bulk order?
Yes. Samples let you confirm fit and finish first.
Do your clutch plates handle heavy loads?
Yes. Our plates are designed to carry passenger and cargo weight without slipping, and friction materials are rated for high temperatures.
Do you supply brake shoes for tuk-tuks?
Yes. Our three-wheeler drum brake shoes offer fade resistance, quiet operation and long lining life.
How are parts packed for upcountry distribution?
Cartons are palletised and labelled by model and part number, so stock can be split and sent onward from Mombasa or Nairobi easily.
